environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) running the Flask monolith directly behind an Application Load Balancer with default settings. ALB performs TLS termination and forwards traffic to port 8080. No additional middleware or rate limiting configured. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The application serves approximately 50,000 invoices across 3,000 user accounts.

config.alb: default listener rules, no WAF attached
